titles.title: Silver Streak
titles.plot: While on a cross-country train ride, overworked book editor George Caldwell (Gene Wilder) begins an unexpected romance with an enigmatic woman named Hilly Burns (Jill Clayburgh). His vacation is interrupted, however, when he witnesses a murder for which he is then accused. The true villains kidnap Hilly and eject Caldwell from the moving train. Desperate, Caldwell teams up with car thief Grover Muldoon (Richard Pryor), and together they must save Hilly while avoiding the police.

titles.title: Phantom
titles.plot: After a series of terror attacks on India, Daniyal is tasked with tracking down the masterminds in India, Europe, America and the Middle East. As he takes down the terrorists one by one, he learns the mission comes with a heavy personal cost.

titles.title: Death Is a Woman
titles.plot: A British narcotics agent (Mark Burns) links a woman (Patsy Ann Noble) to Mediterranean murder and heroin.

titles.title: Skincare: Trailer
titles.plot: A celebrity aesthetician in Hollywood becomes convinced a rival is out to sabotage her business and destroy her life.

titles.title: Anchakkallakokkan
titles.plot: A police constable encounters a criminal who's out for revenge.

titles.title: Bheemla Nayak
titles.plot: Things change when the egos of an upright police officer and a retired army officer clash.

titles.title: Bonds Will Be Broken
titles.plot: A woman infiltrates a mysterious self-improvement cult to save her sister from its sinister leader.

titles.title: Bonhoeffer: Pastor. Spy. Assassin.
titles.plot: As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, Dietrich Bonhoeffer is swept into the epicenter of a deadly plot to assassinate Hitler. With his faith and fate at stake, Bonhoeffer must choose between upholding his moral convictions or risking it all to save millions of Jews from genocide. Will his shift from preaching peace to plotting murder alter the course of history or cost him everything?

titles.title: Catch the Fair One
titles.plot: A Native American boxer embarks on the fight of her life when she goes in search of her missing sister.

titles.title: Chakravyuh
titles.plot: Adil enlists the help of his friend Kabir to infiltrate a Naxal organization. The plan succeeds, but Kabir starts sympathizing with the Naxals, a choice that puts him at war with his best friend.

titles.title: Conspirator
titles.plot: Maj. Michael Curragh (Robert Taylor), an Englishman, and American Melinda Greyton (Elizabeth Taylor) get married, but she has no idea he's working as a spy for the USSR. The Soviets quickly make it clear they're worried his identity will be revealed, so they tell Michael to kill his bride. The Soviet fears are well-founded, as Melinda is in the process of uncovering her husband's secret, and the newlyweds find themselves wrestling with the hazardous complications of espionage and love.

titles.title: Containment
titles.plot: Residents of an apartment block wake up to discover that they are sealed inside their building. They must work together to find out why before they start to turn on one another.

titles.title: Crumb Catcher
titles.plot: At a remote estate in upstate New York, newlyweds Leah (Ella Rae Peck) and Shane (Rigo Garay) celebrate their honeymoon, but a pall hangs over their union. She works for the publisher who will be releasing his debut novel, a lightly autobiographical examination of family trauma, alcoholism, and the immigrant experience. Barely suppressed tensions over family trauma would be enough kindling for a blowup, but Leah and Shane's marriage is truly tested by the appearance of two weirdos with entrepreneurial zeal and a half-baked blackmail plot: John (John Speredakos) and Rose (Lorraine Farris). They're looking for investors for John's latest invention, a culinary breakthrough called the Crumb Catcher -- and they won't take no for an answer.

titles.title: Disquiet
titles.plot: Jonathan Rhys Meyers stars in the terrifying, edge-of-your-seat thriller. After a near-fatal car accident, Sam (Meyers) wakes to discover he is trapped in an abandoned hospital by mysterious and sinister forces that have no intention of letting him leave!

titles.title: Yagna
titles.plot: The people of an unnamed kingdom are suffering, thanks to the greed and madness of King Jaywardhan (Sharmila Tagore). Meanwhile, the rebellious Prince Harshwardhan (Sanjay Dutt) has spent years living in seclusion, wanting no part of royal life and its treacheries, until the queen abruptly dies. Then a letter informs the prince that his birth father is Eklavya (Amitabh Bachchan), a royal guard with legendary aim, who is being targeted for death by the king and his vile brother (Vidya Balan).

titles.title: Fan
titles.plot: A man (Shah Rukh Khan) develops a dangerous obsession with a movie star who looks just like him.

titles.title: Favor
titles.plot: After a casual fling results in a woman's death, a man (Blayne Weaver) calls on an old pal (Patrick Day) to help him dispose of the body.

titles.title: Girl
titles.plot: A young woman returns to her hometown to exact revenge on her abusive father. She soon finds herself prey to a sinister sheriff when she uncovers a family legacy more disturbing than she'd imagined.

titles.title: Hotel Mumbai
titles.plot: November 26, 2008 ... terror struck the heart of India. From the producer of Sicario and Wind River.

titles.title: Incision
titles.plot: A surgeon gets caught up in an illegal organ-harvesting ring when she tries to track down those responsible for her sister's assault.

titles.title: Inheritance
titles.plot: When Maya (Phoebe Dynevor) learns that her father was once a spy, she suddenly finds herself at the center of an international conspiracy. In her quest for answers, Maya becomes a target and must travel the globe, mastering her father's skills and unraveling the mysteries of his past in this gripping espionage thriller.

titles.title: Maigret Lays a Trap
titles.plot: The police detective (Jean Gabin) investigates the knifing of four women in Paris.

titles.title: Intrusion
titles.plot: When a husband and wife move to a small town, a home invasion leaves the wife traumatized and suspicious that those around her might not be who they seem.

titles.title: Irul
titles.plot: When a car breakdown forces a couple to seek shelter in a nearby home, conversations with the stranger inside soon suggest there's a killer among them.

titles.title: Karen
titles.plot: KAREN follows Karen Drexler (Taryn Manning), a racist white woman who makes it her personal mission to displace the new Black family that has just moved in next door to her. Community activist Malik (Cory Hardrict) and his wife Imani (Jasmine Burke) are the couple who have just moved to the Atlanta suburb, but they won't be backing down without a fight.

titles.title: Keep Breathing
titles.plot: Two young women, both victims of the same dead rapist, suspect that a new monster may be in their midst, committing horrifying crimes.

titles.title: Lady Terror
titles.plot: A young lawyer saves a damsel in distress and gets wrapped up in her mystery. His heart overflows with love for her, but he has no idea what she is playing at.

titles.title: Lost Angel
titles.plot: When Lisa returns home to the small island of Newpoint after the mysterious death of her sister, she is drawn into a dangerous and unsettling quest to uncover the truth. As she begins to suspect sinister criminal underworld connections, she meets her only ally in her mission for justice -- a charming man name Rich, who is hiding his own dark secrets, and his role linking to her sister’s demise.

titles.title: Mardaani 2
titles.plot: Shivani Shivaji Roy locks horns with a remorseless serial killer who is raping and murdering young women.

titles.title: Masquerade
titles.plot: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until a group of intruders, led by Rose, breaks in. They plan to steal her family's priceless collection of artworks, but their reckless ambition is outmatched only by Rose's opportunism. As the stakes grow even higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

titles.title: The Morning After
titles.plot: Failed actress Alex Sternbergen (Jane Fonda) wakes up hungover one morning in an apartment she does not recognize, unable to remember the previous evening -- and with a dead body in bed next to her. As she tries to piece together the events of the night, Alex cannot totally rely on friends or her estranged husband, Joaquin (Raul Julia), for assistance. Only a single ally, loner ex-policeman Turner Kendall (Jeff Bridges), can help her escape her predicament and find the true killer.

titles.title: Plain Sight
titles.plot: An exotic dancer is determined to build her own empire and create a better life for her and her brother, then someone threatens to destroy her plans.

titles.title: Plan A
titles.plot: Germany 1945, Max, a Jewish Holocaust survivor, meets a radical group of Jewish resistance fighters, who, like him, lost all hope for their future after they were robbed of their existence and their entire families were killed by the Nazis. They dream of retaliation on an epic scale for the Jewish people. An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Max starts identifying with the group's monstrous plans...

titles.title: Poirot: Evil Under the Sun
titles.plot: Hercule Poirot cuts short his holiday to investigate the murder of a woman at a stylish beach resort.

titles.title: Prove Your Love
titles.plot: An agnostic man is seduced by a demoness who's intent on destroying religious institutions and urges him to take out his ex-girlfriend and her church.

titles.title: Red Dot
titles.plot: On a hiking trip to rekindle their marriage, a couple find themselves fleeing for their lives in the unforgiving wilderness from an unknown shooter.

titles.title: RUB
titles.plot: Meet Neal. He's lonely, gets bullied at work, and is unlucky in love. At the suggestion of a co-worker he decides to go to a massage parlor and in the process his life changes in ways he never would have imagined.

titles.title: Sinister Surgeon
titles.plot: A young doctor's dream job with a top cosmetic surgeon becomes a nightmare when she fears that he may secretly be murdering his patients.

titles.title: Sins of the Bride
titles.plot: A bride's revenge fling with the best man turns her world upside down when her supposedly AWOL groom returns, leading to a fraught marriage haunted by guilt and a vindictive secret-holder bent on destroying their fragile happily ever after.

titles.title: Suburban Nightmare
titles.plot: Struggling to make ends meet, a family uses an app to rent out a spare room. Unknowingly, they invite a man with a violent past into their home.

titles.title: The Tall Target
titles.plot: Abraham Lincoln will be traveling by rail to his inauguration in Washington and a plot is being hatched to assassinate him as he passes through Baltimore. New York detective John Kennedy (Dick Powell) tries to alert his superiors to the scheme, but his suspicions are dismissed. He decides to quit the force and boards the train to try to thwart the assassins himself. He's unsure of whom he can trust but finds a potential ally in Ginny Beaufort (Paula Raymond), the sister of one of the plotters.

titles.title: The Dead Center
titles.plot: A psychiatrist's sanity is pushed to the edge when a patient with amnesia insists he has died and has come back from the other side with something terrible.

titles.title: The Deceitful Wife
titles.plot: Hoping to find love again, a widower dives into the online dating world, but soon realizes his journey has taken an unforeseen and nightmarish turn.

titles.title: The Devil to Pay
titles.plot: A struggling mother fights to save her son from the cold-hearted matriarch of a family.

titles.title: The Dig
titles.plot: A convicted murderer is released from prison with no memory of his crime and is forced to help the victim's father dig for the body.

titles.title: The Influencer
titles.plot: A social media influencer rises to the cusp of stardom only to be thrown into a fight for her life and the lives of those closest to her.

titles.title: The Manifestation
titles.plot: When a desperate day trader manifests a twin version of his wife to help him build a fortune, he soon discovers she may have a much darker agenda.

titles.title: The Midnight Phantom
titles.plot: A criminologist (Reginald Denny) links a reporter (Lloyd Hughes) to the murder of a police chief.

titles.title: The Open House
titles.plot: A teenager and his mother find themselves besieged by threatening forces when they move into a new house.

titles.title: The Path
titles.plot: A young woman returns to her childhood home and discovers strange circumstances surrounding her parent's death and the town in which she grew up.

titles.title: The Photo Book
titles.plot: As bodies begin piling up at a campsite, two couples decide to head to the woods despite warnings that an active serial killer is on the loose.

titles.title: The Shattering
titles.plot: Claire has it all--a loving husband, wealth, and a baby on the way. As her due date looms, events take an unexpected turn and reality begins to shatter. With the arrival of a beautiful psychiatrist--ostensibly to help her--the truth becomes increasingly opaque. Can Claire uncover what's really going on, or will the secret kill her?

titles.title: The Weekend Away
titles.plot: A weekend getaway to Croatia goes awry when a woman is accused of killing her best friend and her efforts to get to the truth uncover a painful secret.

titles.title: Three Identical Strangers
titles.plot: Identical triplets become separated at birth and adopted by three different families. Years later, their amazing reunion becomes a global sensation but also unearths an unimaginable secret that has radical repercussions.

titles.title: Truth & Treason
titles.plot: As World War II rages, a teenage boy in Germany is forced to confront a terrible truth--loyalty to his country now means loyalty to a lie. When his trusted bishop urges obedience to the Nazi regime, he begins to question everything. And after his Jewish friend is taken away, he secretly listens to banned radio broadcasts and launches a resistance, exposing the truth. But in a nation ruled by fear, defiance comes at a cost--and as the regime closes in, he must decide what it truly means to be a good German.

titles.title: Tyger Tyger
titles.plot: A woman and a drug dealer distribute stolen, life-saving medication to desperate people during a pandemic.

titles.title: War
titles.plot: Secret agent Kabir goes rogue after a mission to catch a terrorist goes awry. His boss sends Khalid, another agent and Kabir's former student, to track him down.

titles.title: Who's Stalking My Family
titles.plot: A woman discovers that someone wants her dead after her teenage daughter starts tutoring a new student.

titles.title: Woman With the Red Lipstick
titles.plot: Looking to spice things up, Lucy and her boyfriend assume fake names and pretend to meet for the first time in a hotel bar. Days later, Lucy sees a news report about a missing person who has the same name that she just used.

titles.title: Woodland Grey
titles.plot: A man living alone in the deep woods finds Emily, a hiker, unconscious and laying on the forest floor. He brings her back to his home and helps her get back to health so she can leave the forest and get home. After a few tense days coexisting, Emily makes a discovery. She finds a crudely built shed behind the man's home. When she opens it, she unleashes something truly haunting. As Emily and the man come to terms with what has been released, they also attempt to find a way out of the forest which isn't exactly what it seems.
